edits.content:
version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: fct_world_output_daily
  description: 'Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: world real output on each
    UTC day from GTA 5''s release (2013-09-17) to the day before GTA 6''s (2026-11-18), and the running
    total since GTA 5. One row per day. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative
    output across days.'
  model: ref('fct_world_output_daily')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: output_day
  entities:
  - name: world_output_day
    type: primary
    expr: output_day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: output_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day of the wait.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: data_year
    type: categorical
    description: Calendar year of the day.
  - name: is_estimate
    type: categorical
    description: True when the day's year is carried by IMF growth (2026).
  measures:
  - name: daily_output
    agg: sum
    expr: daily_output
    description: World real output made on the day, constant 2015 US$ (the year spread evenly).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          additivity: additive
          null_rule: NULL when the year's output is unavailable.
  - name: cumulative_output
    agg: max
    expr: cumulative_output
    description: Running total of world real output since GTA 5's release, through the day. Never sum
      it across days.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: output_day
      window_choice: max
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          additivity: semi_additive
          null_rule: NULL from the first unavailable day on.
- name: fct_wait_milestones
  description: 'Metric 3: the milestones of the wait between GTA 5 and GTA 6 (editorial picks, one public
    source each), each with the world real output made since GTA 5 by the day before it. One row per milestone.
    Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.'
  model: ref('fct_wait_milestones')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: event_date
  entities:
  - name: milestone
    type: primary
    expr: milestone_id
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: event_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day of the event.
  - name: milestone_id
    type: categorical
    description: Slug.
  - name: title
    type: categorical
    description: What happened.
  - name: chart_label
    type: categorical
    description: Short label for the chart.
  - name: category
    type: categorical
    description: Theme; rockstar marks the Rockstar nods.
  - name: tier
    type: categorical
    description: anchor (the two releases), hero (headline moments) or long.
  - name: is_editorial
    type: categorical
    description: True for the editorial milestones, the ones the Metric 3 chart draws.
  - name: date_precision
    type: categorical
    description: day, or month.
  - name: source_url
    type: categorical
    description: One public source for the date.
  measures:
  - name: output_by_then
    agg: max
    expr: output_by_then
    description: World real output made from GTA 5's release through the day before the event, constant
      2015 US$.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          additivity: semi_additive
          null_rule: NULL outside the wait.
  - name: share_of_wait_output
    agg: max
    expr: share_of_wait_output
    description: output_by_then over the whole wait's output (0 to 1).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: fraction
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: days_to_gta_6
    agg: max
    expr: days_to_gta_6
    description: Days from the event to GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          additivity: non_additive

version: 2

semantic_models:
  - name: fct_world_productivity
    description: 'Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6: world productivity per year from 2013 to 2026 and its real change since GTA 5''s launch year. One row per measure per year. Population: Every year from var gta_v_year (2013) to var gta_6_year (2026) for both measures, published or not; an unpublished, unestimated year keeps its row with a NULL value.'
    model: ref('fct_world_productivity')
    defaults:
      agg_time_dimension: year_start
    entities:
      - name: world_productivity_key
        type: primary
        expr: world_productivity_key
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              null_rule: never
    dimensions:
      - name: measure
        type: categorical
        description: output_per_worker or output_per_person.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              null_rule: never
      - name: data_year
        type: categorical
        description: Calendar year the value describes.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              null_rule: never
      - name: year_start
        type: time
        type_params:
          time_granularity: day
        description: '1 January of data_year: the time axis.'
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              null_rule: never
      - name: launch
        type: categorical
        description: GTA 5 on 2013, GTA 6 on 2026, NULL in between.
    measures:
      - name: value
        agg: max
        expr: value
        description: Real output in the measure's unit.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              unit: see unit column
              null_rule: 'NULL when unpublished and not estimated: unavailable, never zero.'
              additivity: non_additive
      - name: pct_change_since_gta_v
        agg: max
        expr: pct_change_since_gta_v
        description: Real change since GTA 5's launch year, in percent.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              unit: percent
              null_rule: NULL when the year's value is unavailable.
              additivity: non_additive
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          population:
            rule: Every year from var gta_v_year (2013) to var gta_6_year (2026) for both measures, published or not; an unpublished, unestimated year keeps its row with a NULL value.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Measures of productivity
              chosen: World Bank GDP per person employed and GDP per capita, world aggregate, real
              evidence: request
              detail: 'user: productivity measured by actual economic indexes (GDP per capita) for the whole world, economic data only'
              column: measure
            - decision: Years covered
              chosen: 2013 to 2026, every year
              evidence: request
              detail: 'user: bookended by the GTA 5 and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)'
              column: data_year
            - decision: Years the World Bank has not published
              chosen: per capita carried by IMF WEO world real GDP growth less latest World Bank population growth, flagged is_estimate; per worker left NULL
              evidence: default
              detail: the IMF WEO is the standard published source for the current year; no free published world employment growth to carry output per worker
              column: value

version: 2
metrics:
- name: day_off_index
  label: Day-Off Index
  description: 'Average year-over-year change, in percent, of US Google searches for call in sick, sick
    day and day off work over the configured window (canonical: 1-14 Nov 2026 vs 2-15 Nov 2025). 50 =
    searches up 50% on average. Never report it alone: always with its breakdown (group by day_off_index_window__breakdown,
    or query day_off_index_term_change by day_off_index_term__term).'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: day_off_index_measure
- name: day_off_index_term_change
  label: Day-Off Index, change by phrase
  description: 'The breakdown: one phrase''s year-over-year change in average weekly search interest,
    in percent. Group by day_off_index_term__term.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_pct_change
- name: day_off_index_term_current
  label: Search interest, current window
  description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the current window (0-100 on that phrase's
    own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_current_avg_interest
- name: day_off_index_term_prior
  label: Search interest, a year earlier
  description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the same weeks a year earlier (0-100 on
    that phrase's own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_prior_avg_interest
- name: signal_value
  label: Signal value
  description: Daily value of a signal. Always group by signal_day__source and signal_day__signal; never
    add across signals.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
- name: day_off_mentions
  label: Day-off mentions
  description: Posts saying someone is taking time off (any reason), summed over seed phrases. Group by
    signal_day__source.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''posts:day_off''

    '
- name: day_off_mentions_gta
  label: Day-off mentions that say GTA
  description: Posts saying someone is taking time off that also mention GTA.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''posts:day_off_gta''

    '
- name: gta_share_of_day_off_talk
  label: GTA share of day-off talk
  description: Day-off posts that mention GTA, as a share of all day-off posts. A fraction (0 to 1). Thursday-is-chattier
    effects cancel out.
  type: ratio
  type_params:
    numerator: day_off_mentions_gta
    denominator: day_off_mentions
- name: gta_wiki_pageviews
  label: GTA 6 Wikipedia pageviews
  description: Daily user pageviews of the English Wikipedia article Grand Theft Auto VI. The hype line.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi''

    '

- name: world_productivity
  label: World productivity
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6. World real output in one year, in the measure''s unit: output_per_worker is World Bank GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP $), output_per_person is World Bank GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$). Always group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year; never add across measures or years.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: value

- name: world_productivity_change_since_gta_v
  label: World productivity, change since GTA 5
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6. Real change in world productivity since GTA 5''s launch year (2013), in percent. Group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year. The headline year is 2026 (GTA 6) for output_per_person, an estimate carried by IMF world real GDP growth, and the latest published year for output_per_worker (2026 reads NULL: unavailable).'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: pct_change_since_gta_v

- name: world_output_produced
  label: World output made while waiting for GTA 6
  description: 'Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6. World real output (World Bank
    NY.GDP.MKTP.KD) made over the days asked for. With no group-by it is the headline: everything made from
    GTA 5''s release (17 Sep 2013) to the day before GTA 6 (18 Nov 2026), 4,811 days. Constant 2015 US$;
    2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: daily_output

- name: world_output_cumulative
  label: World output since GTA 5, running total
  description: Metric 3. Running total of world real output since GTA 5's release, as of each day. Group
    by world_output_day__output_day or metric_time; at week or month grain it reads the period's last day.
    Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: cumulative_output

- name: world_output_per_second
  label: World output per second
  description: 'Metric 3. The rate the world makes things at: one day''s world real output / 86,400. Only
    meaningful by day: group by world_output_day__output_day (or metric_time__day). A yearly average spread
    evenly; nobody measures GDP by the second. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add
    cumulative output across days.'
  type: derived
  type_params:
    expr: world_output_produced / 86400
    metrics:
    - name: world_output_produced

- name: wait_milestone_output
  label: World output made by each milestone
  description: Metric 3. World real output made since GTA 5's release by the day before each milestone.
    Group by milestone__title and milestone__event_date (milestone__is_editorial = true for the chart). Milestones
    are editorial picks, not a ranking. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative
    output across days.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: output_by_then

- name: wait_milestone_share
  label: Share of the wait's output made by each milestone
  description: Metric 3. wait_milestone_output over the whole wait's output (0 to 1). Group by milestone.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: share_of_wait_output

- name: wait_milestone_days_to_gta_6
  label: Days from each milestone to GTA 6
  description: Metric 3. Days from the milestone to GTA 6's release day (19 Nov 2026). Group by milestone.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: days_to_gta_6
